features.name: Horns
features.description: Your horns are natural weapons. Your unarmed strikes with them deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Charge
features.description: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or shove a creature. If you moved at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, the attack deals an extra 5 damage on a hit. If you shove the creature instead, it takes 5 bludgeoning damage and, on a successful shove, is pushed up to 10 feet away from you.

features.name: Hammering Horns
features.description: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to push it with your horns. The target must be within 5 feet and no more than one size larger than you. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

features.name: Labyrinthine Recall
features.description: You always know which direction is north, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks you make to navigate or track.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die.
